node.statement: Choose universal constants C_pol and kappa_pol so that every occurrence below of C_ch*(epsilon_r+c*delta), every Neumann error, and every fixed finite product/associator error is at most 1/8 whenever C_pol*(epsilon_r+delta)<=kappa_pol; under this guard the algebraic coordinate estimates in node 1.1 hold uniformly.
